name: PubMedQA
description: PubMedQA is a biomedical research question answering dataset where questions are formed from PubMed article titles and answers (yes/no/maybe) with supporting context from corresponding abstracts, used for biomedical LLM evaluation.

name: MedQA
description: MedQA is a multiple-choice medical question answering dataset derived from professional medical licensing examinations in multiple countries/languages, widely used to evaluate clinical and biomedical knowledge of LLMs.

name: MIMIC I
source: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center ICU
description: MIMIC I (Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care I) is an early-version critical care database containing de-identified health-related data of patients admitted to the ICU, including vital signs, laboratory results, and medications.

name: MIMIC II
source: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center ICU
description: MIMIC II is a critical care database providing de-identified health data for patients admitted to critical care units, containing clinical notes, laboratory values, and drug administration records.

name: MIMIC III
aim: Critical care clinical records for NLP and ML
source: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center ICU, 2001–2012
description: MIMIC-III is a large, freely available critical care database containing de-identified health data including clinical notes, diagnoses, medications, lab results, and procedures, widely used for clinical NLP and ML research.

name: MIMIC IV
source: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center ICU, 2008–2019
description: MIMIC-IV is the most recent version of the MIMIC critical care database, covering admissions from 2008–2019 with updated data structure, new ED and hospital modules, and expanded free-text clinical note coverage.

name: PubMed Central Open Access Subset
description: The PMC Open Access Subset provides bulk download access to the full text of open-access articles in PubMed Central, widely used for biomedical NLP pre-training, literature mining, and corpus construction.

name: BioASQ
description: BioASQ is a large-scale biomedical semantic indexing and question answering challenge dataset with expert-annotated yes/no, factoid, list, and summary questions based on biomedical literature from PubMed.

name: OpenBioLink
source: Integrated from UniProt, DisGeNET, CTD, GO, Reactome, etc.
description: OpenBioLink is a large-scale biomedical benchmark framework for link prediction in knowledge graphs, providing standardized train/test splits with temporal and quality-filtered data for reproducible evaluation.

name: DisGeNET
source: Literature mining + expert curation (OMIM, UniProt, ClinVar, etc.)
description: DisGeNET is one of the largest knowledge platforms integrating data on human disease-gene associations and variants, curated from multiple sources including databases and the scientific literature.

name: eICU Collaborative Research DB
description: The eICU Collaborative Research Database is a multi-center critical care database of ICU patients from ~208 hospitals across the US, providing high-resolution physiologic, treatment, and outcome data for clinical research.

name: Medical Information Mart (MIMIC-CXR)
aim: Chest X-ray imaging with clinical reports
description: MIMIC-CXR is a large publicly available dataset of chest radiographs with paired free-text radiology reports, enabling multimodal NLP and image analysis research in clinical settings.

name: i2b2/VA 2010 Concepts/Assertions/Relations
aim: Clinical NER and relation extraction (problems, tests, treatments)
description: The i2b2/VA 2010 NLP challenge dataset contains clinical discharge summaries annotated with medical problems, tests, and treatments (including medications), along with assertion types and relations between entities, supporting clinical NLP research.

name: MedNLI
aim: Natural language inference in clinical text
description: MedNLI is a natural language inference dataset for the clinical domain, created from MIMIC-III clinical notes, providing sentence pairs labeled for entailment, contradiction, or neutral relationships.

name: emrQA
description: emrQA is a large-scale QA dataset automatically generated over electronic medical records by leveraging existing i2b2 clinical NLP annotations, supporting span-selection QA over de-identified clinical text.

name: Orphanet
description: Orphanet is the reference portal for rare diseases and orphan drugs, providing disease descriptions, epidemiology data, diagnostic criteria, and links to guidelines and expert resources for ~10,000 rare diseases.

name: CCLE (Cancer Cell Line Encyclopedia)
description: The CCLE (Cancer Cell Line Encyclopedia) provides detailed genetic characterization including whole-exome sequencing, RNA-seq, proteomics, and drug sensitivity data for ~1,800 human cancer cell lines.

name: MedMCQA
aim: Medical MCQ benchmark for LLM evaluation
description: MedMCQA is a large-scale multiple-choice QA dataset collected from Indian medical entrance examinations (AIIMS PG, NEET PG), covering 2,400+ clinical subjects for evaluating medical knowledge of AI models.

name: MedQuAD
aim: Medical question answering from NIH websites
description: MedQuAD (Medical Question Answering Dataset) contains medical QA pairs compiled from 12 NIH websites including MedlinePlus, covering information on diseases, drugs, treatments, and medical tests.

name: ChatDoctor Dataset
aim: Medical dialogue for LLM instruction tuning
source: HealthCareMagic and iCliniq online medical platforms
description: The ChatDoctor Dataset contains real patient-doctor conversations from online medical consultation platforms, used for fine-tuning and instruction-tuning LLMs for medical dialogue and patient-facing AI applications.

name: CORD-19
source: PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv, WHO COVID-19 database
description: CORD-19 (COVID-19 Open Research Dataset) is a large corpus of scientific papers about COVID-19 and related coronaviruses assembled to support AI research for the scientific and medical communities during the pandemic.

name: LitCovid
description: LitCovid is a curated literature hub for tracking up-to-date scientific information about COVID-19 in PubMed, providing article categorization by topic (prevention, treatment, mechanism, etc.).

name: BIOSSES
description: BIOSSES is a benchmark for biomedical semantic textual similarity, containing 100 sentence pairs sampled from the CRAFT corpus and TAC data, with manual similarity annotations for evaluating biomedical NLP models.

name: MedSTS
description: MedSTS is a clinical semantic textual similarity corpus containing sentence pairs from clinical notes with expert semantic similarity scores, designed for evaluating NLP models in the clinical domain.

name: BLUE Benchmark
source: Aggregated from multiple biomedical NLP tasks
description: BLUE (Biomedical Language Understanding Evaluation) is a collection of NLP benchmarks for evaluation of biomedical text mining models, covering NER, RE, STS, NLI, and QA using datasets from clinical notes and biomedical literature.

name: BLURB Benchmark
description: BLURB (Biomedical Language Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark) is a comprehensive benchmark for biomedical NLP, consisting of 13 tasks from diverse biomedical datasets for systematic model evaluation.

name: iKraph
source: NLP mining of PubMed and clinical literature
description: iKraph is a biomedical knowledge graph constructed from large-scale literature mining, extracting entities and relationships from PubMed to support drug discovery and disease mechanism exploration.

name: PubMed Knowledge Graph (PKG)
description: The PubMed Knowledge Graph (PKG) is extracted from PubMed by integrating entity linking with biomedical ontologies and relation extraction, providing a large-scale knowledge resource for biomedical AI.

name: CKG (Clinical Knowledge Graph)
description: CKG (Clinical Knowledge Graph) is an open-source platform for biomarker interpretation, integrating 26 databases into a graph of diseases, drugs, proteins, and clinical data to support proteomics-based biomarker discovery.

name: Monarch Initiative
source: Integrated from OMIM, HPO, MGI, ZFIN, etc.
description: The Monarch Initiative is a resource integrating genetic and disease data across multiple species to enable deep phenotyping, cross-species disease modeling, and gene-disease-phenotype relationship analysis.

name: UniProt
description: UniProt is the world's leading database of protein sequence and functional information, providing comprehensive annotation of protein functions, post-translational modifications, and cross-references to other databases.

name: STRING
description: STRING (Search Tool for the Retrieval of Interacting Genes/Proteins) provides a comprehensive database of known and predicted protein-protein interactions, covering physical and functional associations.

name: Gene Ontology (GO)
description: Gene Ontology (GO) provides a standardized framework and vocabulary to describe gene and gene product attributes across species, organized into three domains: molecular function, biological process, and cellular component.

name: Disease Ontology (DO)
source: Community curation, integration with OMIM, MeSH, SNOMED
description: The Disease Ontology (DO) provides an open computable human disease ontology integrating MeSH, ICD, NCI Thesaurus, SNOMED, and OMIM disease codes, enabling cross-mapping and standardized disease representation.

name: HPO (Human Phenotype Ontology)
aim: Human phenotype standardization for rare diseases
description: HPO (Human Phenotype Ontology) provides a standardized vocabulary of phenotypic abnormalities encountered in human disease, with computable phenotype annotations for Mendelian diseases and broad clinical use.

name: OMIM (Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man)
aim: Genetic disorders and disease gene catalog
description: OMIM is a comprehensive, authoritative compendium of human genes and genetic phenotypes with full-text, referenced overviews, emphasizing the relationship between phenotype and genotype.

name: ClinVar
description: ClinVar is an NCBI archive reporting relationships among medically important variants and human phenotypes, providing clinical significance classifications from submitting laboratories and experts.

name: Europe PMC
description: Europe PMC is a repository of biomedical literature providing open access to published research, preprints, and grey literature, offering full-text search, text mining annotations, and data availability links.

name: GWAS Catalog
description: The NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog is a curated collection of all published GWAS with single nucleotide polymorphism-trait associations, enabling systematic analysis of genetic architecture of complex traits and diseases.

name: Reactome
description: Reactome is a free, open-source, curated and peer-reviewed pathway database providing molecular details of signal transduction, transport, DNA replication, metabolism, and other cellular processes.

name: TCGA (The Cancer Genome Atlas)
description: TCGA (The Cancer Genome Atlas) is a landmark cancer genomics program that molecularly characterized over 20,000 primary cancers across 33 types using multi-omics platforms including WGS, RNA-seq, methylation, and proteomics.

name: GTEx (Genotype-Tissue Expression)
aim: Gene expression and eQTL across tissues
description: GTEx provides a comprehensive public resource for studying tissue-specific gene expression and regulation, containing eQTL data linking genetic variants to gene expression changes across 54 human tissues.

name: PDB (Protein Data Bank)
description: The PDB (Protein Data Bank) is the global archive for 3D structural data of large biological molecules including proteins, nucleic acids, and complex assemblies, determined by X-ray crystallography, NMR, and cryo-EM.

name: MeSH Drug Pharmacological Actions
description: MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) Drug Pharmacological Actions provides a hierarchical classification of pharmacological actions of drugs used for indexing biomedical literature, supporting systematic drug classification.
